text:
Maya (CSM): Kickoff for Acme / Catalyst onboarding — syncing stakeholders, success criteria, timeline, and risks. Can everyone confirm availability for a short triage 1PM PT today? Link: https://calendly.com/redwood/kickoff
Evan (Solutions Eng): 1PM works for me. Quick note: we need Acme to whitelist our egress IPs and confirm service account scopes. IPs: ```34.72.16.90/32, 34.72.16.91/32```
Zoë (Enablement): I'll own enablement sessions. Plan: 1) Dev quickstart (30m) 2) Ops runbook + SSO (45m). Suggested week of 2026-04-01. Will record and drop a short survey after each session.
Carlos (Success Ops): Proposed high-level milestones: 1) Account/access ready — target 2026-03-25 2) PoC metrics + eval harness — target 2026-04-08 3) Pilot launch (small subset) — target 2026-04-22. Note: if PoC slips >2 weeks, renewal risk flag.
Maya (CSM): Success criteria I want captured before we call: 1) Acme can make authenticated API calls from their environment 2) 95th pct latency for 512-token payloads <200ms on dedicated pool 3) Embedding quality >=0.85 on their eval set 4) Runbook + escalation triage doc in Confluence. If you think any of these are unreasonable, flag it.
Evan (Solutions Eng): Those look reasonable. Action items on our side: create eval harness, share sample prompts, and add a sandbox API key. I'll push the harness to repo: https://git.redwood/eng/acme-evals and add instructions. Note: need sanitized test data from Acme.
Zoë (Enablement): Enablement plan will include: pre-read, live 30m dev walkthrough, 45m ops session, and a 15-min office hours in week 1. We'll use a short survey (Net Promoter + 3 custom Qs) to capture early feedback.
Maya (CSM): Risks: legal/MSA not signed yet (can block Dedicated/Private deployments), network provisioning delays, and data privacy questions around sample data. Carlos — can you track MSA status and call out blockers earlier?
Carlos (Success Ops): Yep — adding MSA + network tasks to the onboarding epic and assigning owners. I'll create a Jira epic (RED-2345) and add the milestones. Also creating a renewal-risk threshold field on the epic so we get alerts if milestones are missed.
Onboardbot: Task created: "Acme whitelist + API key" assigned to Evan, due 2026-03-25. Task created: "Enablement sessions" assigned to Zoë, due 2026-04-05.
Evan (Solutions Eng): Small tech note: for private deployments we'll need an IPsec tunnel or VPN. If Acme prefers VPC peering, they'll need their network team on the call.
Maya (CSM): OK — locking dates for now: access target 2026-03-25, PoC review 2026-04-08, pilot 2026-04-22. @everyone please react with :thumbsup: if good or reply with blockers. I'll drop a short agenda before 1PM PT.
Zoë (Enablement): :thumbsup: I’ll draft the enablement slides and survey questions and share by EOD.
Carlos (Success Ops): Adding owners in Jira now. Will ping legal on MSA status and loop in renewals if things slip.
Maya (CSM): Thanks team — main owners: Maya (CSM) for overall, Evan for tech tasks, Zoë for enablement, Carlos for ops & risk. cc @Priya (Acme PM) for confirmations on their side. See you at 1PM PT.
